    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Date
    Represents a calendar date used in a parking timestamp.
    Deck
    Represents a parking deck.
    DeckList
    Stores parking decks in a resizable array.
    ErrorType
    Defines error messages used by the Parking Management System.
    History
    Represents a node in a singly linked list for vehicle parking history.
    Hour
    Represents predefined deck operating hour codes and time intervals.
    Location
    Represents a supported parking-deck location.
    Operation
    Processes commands entered through the terminal.
    Parking
    Represents one parking activity.
    RunProject1
    Provides the entry point for the Parking Management System.
    Timestamp
    Represents a date and time associated with a parking activity.
    Vehicle
    Represents a registered vehicle with its license plate and parking history.
    VehicleList
    Maintains a resizable array for storing and managing registered vehicles.
